summary: Console live-panel freeze and broken trace links during Kinesis backfill window
description:
Issue summary: Multiple customers on Dedicated capacity reported the Console 'Live' dashboard panel freezing (no refresh, spinner stuck) and trace links in panels resolving to 404s during a scheduled Kinesis backfill executed in us-west. Impact: inability to view live session metrics and drill into traces; alerting thresholds tied to live panels delayed. Observed from 2026-03-12T02:14Z to 2026-03-12T03:05Z for most customers that had active backfills.

This ticket centralizes reports from Nimbus Retail and two other tenants that use dedicated ingestion routes. The behavior correlates with high indexing pressure during a backfill job that produced large out-of-order timestamps and caused the trace-indexer to temporarily return stale links and the console websocket connection to stall.
impact: Customers on Dedicated experienced live-dashboard freezes and could not open trace links for ~40 minutes. Several on-call pages were triggered for alerts that rely on live metrics. Business impact: customer-facing dashboards unavailable for monitoring of production jobs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start a large backfill job targeting us-west ingestion (Kinesis). 2) Generate a mix of high-cardinality tracing events and a burst of session metrics with out-of-order timestamps. 3) Open Console -> Live panel for the org using that ingestion route and apply a short timespan filter (last 1 minute). 4) Observe the panel spinner never resolves and trace links in the panel point to /traces/<id> that show 404 from the trace service.
observed_behavior: Live panel UI remains loading indefinitely; trace link click returns 404. Console logs show repeated websocket reconnects and JSON parse errors for SKUs exceeding expected event schema. Trace-indexer returns HTTP 503 for some lookup calls and 200 with empty payloads for others.
expected_behavior: Live panel should refresh regularly (per configured freq) and trace links should resolve to the trace viewer. Backfill should not impact read-only Console behavior beyond temporary increased latency.

investigation_notes: 02:30: initial customer report (Nimbus) - live panel spinner and missing trace links
02:35: SRE observed ingestion backlog on Kinesis shard for dedicated pool; correlated with backfill window
02:45: trace-indexer returning intermittent 503s; suspected index compaction/retention eviction during heavy backfill
02:55: console websocket errors caused by large message envelope sizes from a merged telemetry payload (schema drift from older agent)
03:00: Temporary workaround tested: throttle backfill ingestion rate -> trace-indexer 200 responses return non-empty payloads and console reconnects stabilize
comments: 2026-03-12 02:38 - Aisha Malik (Support): Received first customer report from Nimbus Retail. Collected logs and session IDs, requested SRE assistance. Added priority P1.
2026-03-12 02:45 - Jorge Kim (SRE): Confirmed Kinesis shard backlog growth for dedicated pool 'dp-usw-3'. Opening INT-4405 to investigate indexing thread saturation.

2026-03-12 02:58 - Luca Romano (Eng): Found trace-indexer returning 200 with empty body for traces that were evicted by retention compaction while a query was inflight. Working on adding guard to avoid returning empty payloads.

2026-03-12 03:07 - Aisha Malik (Support): Applied temporary mitigation for Nimbus Retail: paused backfill for 5 minutes, live panels recovered. Customer confirmed temporary workaround acceptable; requesting permanent fix timeline.
2026-03-12 10:12 - Product Ops (note): Scheduling follow-up to harden console against empty-trace responses and add alerting on empty trace hits in trace-indexer. Linked to GH PR 2489.
resolution: Workaround applied: advised customers to throttle/pause Kinesis backfill; SRE patched ingestion throttling to cap burst size for dedicated pools. Engineering change: add defensive check in trace-indexer to treat empty payloads as 503 and surface a clear error to console instead of 200-empty (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2489). Postfix: runbook updated to include backfill throttling guidance and an alert on trace-indexer empty responses. Follow-up: release in next minor (v1.43.2) with monitoring changes.
